hotel_name: Townhouse Rohini Near Rithala Metro Station

negative_snippets:
Worst Stay of My Life – Avoid at All Costs! 🚫

I wish I could give this place zero stars. From the moment I stepped in, I realized I had made a mistake. The staff specifically Dheeraj was very rude, unprofessional, and clearly only interested in squeezing more money out of guests. They tried to scam me by demanding extra charges that were never mentioned during booking. When I refused, their attitude turned hostile.

The rooms are nothing like the pictures—dirty bedsheets, stained walls, and a bathroom that looked like it hadn’t been cleaned in weeks. The AC barely worked, and the Wi-Fi is a joke. Forget about comfort—sleeping here feels like punishment.

Security? Absolutely not. The vibe of the place was unsafe, and I genuinely did not feel comfortable leaving my belongings in the room. The staff hovered around and made me feel watched all the time.

To top it off, there was constant noise from the hallway, leaking taps, and a foul smell that never went away. Breakfast was cold, tasteless, and clearly reheated from the previous day.

This place operates like a trap for unsuspecting travelers—luring you in with decent photos and then trying to rip you off once you arrive. There are much better and safer options nearby for the same price or less.
